title: Redshift Suppression of Nonlinear Scalar Fields in Accelerating FLRW Spacetimes
summary: We study small--data solutions of a nonlinear scalar field equation on spatially flat $d$--dimensional FLRW spacetimes ($d\ge4$). In conformal time $τ$ the field satisfies a damped semilinear wave/Klein--Gordon equation with time--dependent coefficients determined by the scale factor $a(τ)$ and the conformal Hubble rate $H(τ)=\dot a/a$.
